items.description: Local inference you can prove. A single-binary GGUF engine in C: serves, scores, and trains LoRA through the quantized weights it deploys, byte-reproducibly. Tool calls survive the token limit; every run replays as a signed receipt. CPU/CUDA/Metal, OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible.
